chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Allah was not worshipped with anything more superior than chastity of the belly and the private part.
ai.seo_question: What is considered the best form of worship according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) elevates 'iffah' (chastity/restraint) to the pinnacle of worship by linking it to the mastery of two fundamental human drives: hunger and lust. This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on inner discipline as the foundation of spiritual purity, suggesting that controlling the stomach and the private part is not merely ethical but a direct act of divine servitude. It reflects the broader theological view that physical moderation is essential for the soul's ascent.
